integrity: Analytic proof and supplementary reproducible computations; no claim of independent certification or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-volume covariance for two congruent Euclidean balls only; no theorem for unequal balls, other densities, or arbitrary curvature-constrained bodies. Individual three-dimensional lens moments can be recovered from classical cap formulas; historical priority of the all-dimensional monotonicity law remains provisional.
title: Sharp covariance anisotropy law for symmetric Euclidean ball lenses
